result:
All 24 checklist lines were already met, so I changed no code. The results are committed as `CHECKLIST-RESULTS.md` rather than `CHECKLIST.md`. This Mac's filesystem is case-insensitive, so writing `CHECKLIST.md` overwrote the tracked `checklist.md`. I restored the original `checklist.md` and renamed the report; the file itself says why.

I ran `npm test` (69 tests), `npm run e2e` (4 tests) and `npm run build`, and all passed. I also checked the running app on a spare port, because `$PORT` was unset in this session:
- **Puzzles:** I solved all 12 through the UI, including the automatic defender reply in the mate-in-2 puzzles.
- **Layout:** There was no horizontal scroll at 390 px on `/`, `?puzzle` or `?fen`. The 390 px and 1280 px screenshots look fine in dark and light.
- **Console:** I saw no errors or warnings on any page I tried.
- **Perft:** The CLI prints `97862` for Kiwipete at depth 3 when run with `npm run -s`; plain `npm run` also prints npm's own banner, as the notes say.
- **Touch:** I only ran a touch tap, not a touch drag. The board has `touch-action: none`, and drag is built on pointer events that mouse and touch share.

The dev server I started is stopped. The one `vite` process still running belongs to a different project (`arshafa`), so I left it alone. My work is committed on `r1-D`.
